response.sql: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS relative_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS overall_avg_quantity FROM invoice_stats) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.avg_quantity, i.relative_gap, i.avg_quantity - o.overall_avg_quantity AS quantity_difference FROM invoice_stats AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE i.avg_quantity > o.overall_avg_quantity ORDER BY quantity_difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity contains numeric text that can be cast to a number.
An invoice's relative gap uses its summed product costs and summed total costs.

alternatives.interpretation: The relative gap is the average of the line items' relative gaps within each invoice.
